description: This file contains utility functions for deserializing objects from Java in R, including functions to read various data types, structures, and handle deserialization streams, specifically for use with Spark data processing.

methods.name: readObject
methods.description: Reads a Java-serialized object from the connection based on its type.

methods.name: readTypedObject
methods.description: Reads a typed object from the connection, dispatching based on type code.

methods.name: readStringData
methods.description: Reads a UTF-8 string of specified length from the connection.

methods.name: readString
methods.description: Reads a string from the connection, first reading its length.

methods.name: readInt
methods.description: Reads a 4-byte integer from the connection.

methods.name: readDouble
methods.description: Reads an 8-byte double from the connection.

methods.name: readBoolean
methods.description: Reads a boolean value from the connection.

methods.name: readType
methods.description: Reads a single byte type indicator from the connection.

methods.name: readDate
methods.description: Reads a date string and converts it to Date object.

methods.name: readTime
methods.description: Reads a double and converts it to POSIXct time.

methods.name: readArray
methods.description: Reads an array of typed objects from the connection.

methods.name: readList
methods.description: Reads a list of objects, possibly of different types.

methods.name: readEnv
methods.description: Reads an environment (key-value pairs) from the connection.

methods.name: readStruct
methods.description: Reads a struct (named list) from the connection.

methods.name: readRaw
methods.description: Reads raw binary data of specified length.

methods.name: readRawLen
methods.description: Reads raw data of specified length.

methods.name: readDeserialize
methods.description: Reads and unserializes data, handling single or multiple objects.

methods.name: readMultipleObjects
methods.description: Reads multiple objects from a stream until end.

methods.name: readMultipleObjectsWithKeys
methods.description: Reads multiple objects with grouping keys from a stream.

methods.name: readDeserializeInArrow
methods.description: Reads Arrow-formatted binary data and returns data frames.

methods.name: readDeserializeWithKeysInArrow
methods.description: Reads Arrow data along with grouping keys.

methods.name: readRowList
methods.description: Reads a row as a list from a raw connection.
